CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_BikesCoolButE.fr: Ces vélos sont super, mais ils\ncoûtent trop cher !
CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_BikesCoolButE.en: These bikes are cool, but they're\nway expensive!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_CityBikeGoodE.fr: Un simple vélo de ville me suffit.\pAprès tout, on ne peut pas mettre\nun panier de courses sur un VTT.
CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_CityBikeGoodE.en: A plain city bike is good enough\nfor me.\pAfter all, you can't put a shopping\nbasket on a mountain bike.

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedVouc.fr: {PLAYER} a échangé le BON POUR UN\nVÉLO contre une BICYCLETTE.
CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedVouc.en: {PLAYER} exchanged the\nBIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_HowDoYouLikeN.fr: Comment tu trouves ta BICYCLETTE ?\nElle roule bien ?\pTu peux l'emmener sur la PISTE\nCYCLABLE et même dans les grottes !
CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_HowDoYouLikeN.en: How do you like your new BICYCLE?\nDo you like how it rides?\pYou can take it out on CYCLING\nROAD and even into caves!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_OhBikeVoucher.fr: Oh, c'est...\pUn BON POUR UN VÉLO !\pD'accord !\nTiens, voilà !
CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_OhBikeVoucher.en: Oh, that's…\pA BIKE VOUCHER!\pOkay!\nHere you go!

CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WelcomeToBike.fr: Salut ! Bienvenue dans notre\nBOUTIQUE DE VÉLOS.\pOn a le VÉLO qu'il te faut !
CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WelcomeToBike.en: Hi!\nWelcome to our BIKE SHOP.\pHave we got just the BIKE for\nyou!
